---
title: "Fulbright–National Geographic fellowship"
date: 2023-01-15
description: "Support for a year of fieldwork on forests and development in the southern Yucatán."
categories: [award]
---

Leo was named a **Fulbright–National Geographic** and **Fulbright–García Robles** fellow for 2023–2024, supporting a year of fieldwork with communities in the Calakmul–Sian Ka'an Biological Corridor.
